verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component that does not collect or hold user data on a vendor service. A training-data opt-out is a policy for online data services, so this story is a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any data-collection or training-opt-out capability; the Ryzen AI developer link is unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
